ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with high-intensity (white) restricted to outer distal margins; approximate 15:1 ratio of dark to light pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform low-intensity black region covering the central and medial fluke; localized high-intensity white banding appearing as irregular, contiguous thin strips along the extreme distal edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; bounding-box depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; trailing edge contains at least 8 distinct primary indentations (valleys) and corresponding peaks across the combined lobes, creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve that transitions into sharp, acute-angled distal tips; overall shape is symmetrical along the vertical median axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white, tan, and gray) textured pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, consistent with localized biological colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serrations and deep notches on the trailing edges; heavy accumulation of protruding biological matter (encrustations) on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent protruding calcified clusters localized specifically to the terminal points of the fluke lobes.
